scientific_integrity: Complete elementary and Grassmannian proof with separately executable finite checker; finite simulations do not replace proof; classical Hodge decomposition is not presented as new.
scientific_limitations: Only central Euclidean sections of a product of exactly two planar disks and the full-diameter event; no claim for the continuous diameter law or other product bodies. Historical-priority uncertainty remains for older unindexed principal-angle or Clifford-torus literature.
title: Exact Haar diametral-section law for products of two Euclidean disks
